name: ATM V&V Test Copilot
description: Verification & Validation copilot for Air Traffic Management systems. Ingests requirement bundles (ED-153, DO-278A, ISO/IEC 25010), generates test designs, builds scenario matrices (nominal / off-nominal / safety-related), and analyzes test-run outcomes with traceability back to requirements.

tools.name: ingest_requirement_bundle
tools.description: Ingest a set of ATM requirements (ED-153, DO-278A, custom) and tag them by source type, criticality and verification method.

tools.name: generate_test_design
tools.description: Produce a structured test design from an ingested requirement bundle. Maps each requirement to one or more verification objectives.

tools.name: build_scenario_matrix
tools.description: Build a scenario matrix from a test design. Generates nominal, off-nominal and safety scenarios with traceability matrix.

tools.name: analyze_test_run
tools.description: Analyze a completed test run: pass/fail per scenario, requirement coverage achieved, gaps identified.
